description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy and correlation values for several models across different tasks. The horizontal axis represents the model names—Single-task_baseline, Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, Unsupervised_SimCSE, Supervised_SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE—listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy / Correlation,” displays values on a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. For each model, there are three bars representing “Sentiment Acc.,” “STS Corr.,” and “Paraphrase Acc.” as indicated in the legend, colored peach, light blue, and light coral, respectively. For the “Single-task_baseline” model, the “Sentiment Acc.” bar reaches approximately 0.45, the “STS Corr.” bar reaches approximately 0.55, and the “Paraphrase Acc.” bar reaches approximately 0.6. For the “2-Tier SimCSE” model, the “Sentiment Acc.” bar reaches approximately 0.78, the “STS Corr.” bar reaches approximately 0.75, and the “Paraphrase Acc.” bar reaches approximately 0.8. The bars are grouped by model, with each group containing the three accuracy metrics. No bars are visually emphasized.
